ValidationRule.description: Detail products must roll up to a Brand parent. Fires only on create or when Parent Product / Product Type changes, so legacy rows can still be edited.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Parent_Product__c), ISCHANGED(Product_Type__c) ), ISPICKVAL(Product_Type__c, "Detail"), NOT(ISBLANK(Parent_Product__c)), TEXT(Parent_Product__r.Product_Type__c) <> "Brand" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Detail products must have a Brand parent.
